columns.name: root_id
columns.description: Stable ID: 'RT-' + sha1('root|' + root_normalized)[:10]. Synthetic roots use 'SYN-RT-...'.

columns.name: root_raw
columns.description: Root exactly as first written by the primary source record (e.g. template text 'שׁ־מ־ר' or '{{שרש3|..}}').

columns.name: root_normalized
columns.description: Root identity: radicals joined without separator, final forms normalized (ך->כ); ש carries its shin/sin dot (שׁ / שׂ) when resolved (from source radicals, else from the lexeme's vocalized lemma -- see lexemes.shin_sin_resolution), bare ש if unresolved.

columns.name: radical_1
columns.description: First radical (bare letter, shin/sin dot removed; see root_normalized for the dotted form).

columns.name: radical_2
columns.description: Second radical.

columns.name: radical_3
columns.description: Third radical.

columns.name: radical_4
columns.description: Fourth radical (quadriliteral+ roots), else null.

columns.name: radical_5
columns.description: Fifth radical (quinqueliteral roots, Wiktionary-only), else null.

columns.name: root_length
columns.description: Number of radicals.

columns.name: traditional_class
columns.description: Normalized traditional גזרה labels EXPLICITLY given by Wiktionary for this root's lexemes ('+'-joined, sorted), e.g. 'PE_NUN+LAMED_YOD_HE'. Null if no source states one. Never inferred.

columns.name: traditional_class_raw
columns.description: The raw גזרה strings from the sources (' ; '-joined).

columns.name: r1_is_nun
columns.description: radical_1 == נ (computed from radicals).

columns.name: r1_is_yod
columns.description: radical_1 == י.

columns.name: r1_is_waw
columns.description: radical_1 == ו.

columns.name: r1_is_alef
columns.description: radical_1 == א.

columns.name: r2_is_yod
columns.description: radical_2 == י.

columns.name: r2_is_waw
columns.description: radical_2 == ו.

columns.name: r3_is_he
columns.description: radical_3 == ה (literal position 3, also for quadriliterals).

columns.name: r3_is_yod
columns.description: radical_3 == י.

columns.name: r3_is_alef
columns.description: radical_3 == א.

columns.name: rfinal_is_he
columns.description: Last radical == ה.

columns.name: r1_is_guttural
columns.description: radical_1 in {א,ה,ח,ע} (ר is NOT counted as guttural; see has_resh).

columns.name: r2_is_guttural
columns.description: radical_2 in {א,ה,ח,ע}.

columns.name: r3_is_guttural
columns.description: radical_3 in {א,ה,ח,ע}.

columns.name: has_resh
columns.description: Any radical == ר.

columns.name: is_geminate
columns.description: Triliteral root with radical_2 == radical_3.

columns.name: is_reduplicated_quadriliteral
columns.description: Quadriliteral with r1==r3 and r2==r4 (e.g. גלגל).

columns.name: has_weak_radical
columns.description: r1 in {נ,י,ו,א} or r2 in {ו,י} or r3 in {ה,י,א} or geminate (transparent definition; see README).

columns.name: structural_signature
columns.description: Per-radical symbols joined by '.': N=נ Y=י W=ו H=ה A=א X=ח E=ע R=ר C=other; '+GEM' suffix if geminate. e.g. כתב->C.C.C, נפל->N.C.C, קום->C.W.C.

columns.name: structural_class
columns.description: Single primary structural class by fixed priority (quadriliteral > geminate > hollow_candidate > final_he > initial_nun > initial_yod_waw > final_alef > initial_alef > guttural_containing > strong). Computed, not a traditional label.

columns.name: sc_strong
columns.description: No weak radical, no guttural (א ה ח ע), triliteral, not geminate.

columns.name: sc_final_he
columns.description: Triliteral, radical_3 == ה.

columns.name: sc_hollow_candidate
columns.description: Triliteral, radical_2 in {ו,י}. 'Candidate' because some such roots inflect as strong.

columns.name: sc_initial_nun
columns.description: radical_1 == נ.

columns.name: sc_initial_yod_waw
columns.description: radical_1 in {י,ו}.

columns.name: sc_geminate
columns.description: = is_geminate.

columns.name: sc_guttural_containing
columns.description: Any radical in {א,ה,ח,ע}.

columns.name: sc_quadriliteral
columns.description: root_length >= 4.

columns.name: root_orthographic
columns.description: root_normalized with shin/sin dots removed: what the root looks like in unvocalized text.

columns.name: orthographic_root_group_id
columns.description: 'RG-' + sha1(root_orthographic): shared by roots that differ only in shin/sin (e.g. שׂכר / שׁכר). Root-holdout splits group by this ID so that unvocalized strings cannot leak across the split.

columns.name: n_lexemes
columns.description: Number of lexemes (root x binyan) with this root in lexemes table.

columns.name: binyanim
columns.description: Sorted '|'-joined binyanim of this root's lexemes (unknown binyan -> '?').

columns.name: source_primary
columns.description: Primary source asserting the root: 'hewiktionary' or 'synthetic_v1'.

columns.name: source_ids
columns.description: '|'-joined source record identifiers supporting the root (see provenance).

columns.name: confidence
columns.description: Max confidence_root over this root's lexemes.

columns.name: quality_tier
columns.description: Best quality tier among this root's lexemes.

columns.name: quality_flags
columns.description: '|'-joined flags; null if none.

columns.name: lexeme_id
columns.description: Stable ID: 'LX-' + sha1(source + '|' + NFC vocalized lemma [+ '|k' for k-th distinct paradigm])[:10].

columns.name: language
columns.description: ISO 639-3 'heb' (synthetic: 'x-syn-heb').

columns.name: root_id
columns.description: FK to roots. NULL if the root is missing or ambiguous (never guessed).

columns.name: root_radicals_dotted
columns.description: Radicals as given by the source incl. shin/sin dots, '-'-joined (e.g. 'שׂ-ח-ק'); null if not given.

columns.name: shin_sin_resolution
columns.description: How ש radicals got their dot: NA (no ש) | SOURCE (root template) | FORM (read off vocalized lemma) | MIXED | UNRESOLVED; null if no root.

columns.name: root_homonym_index
columns.description: Wiktionary homonym index of the root (e.g. 'א','ב') if given.

columns.name: binyan
columns.description: One of PAAL NIFAL PIEL PUAL HIFIL HUFAL HITPAEL; NULL if missing/ambiguous (never guessed or taken from the shape heuristic).

columns.name: binyan_raw
columns.description: Raw binyan label(s) from sources ('|'-joined).

columns.name: lemma_vocalized
columns.description: NFC vocalized lemma as given by the primary source (UniMorph heb_voc lemma column / Wiktionary headword).

columns.name: lemma_unvocalized
columns.description: Plene (ktiv male) unvocalized lemma: UniMorph 'heb' lemma of the paired paradigm, or Wiktionary 'כתיב מלא'.

columns.name: infinitive_vocalized
columns.description: NFIN cell, vocalized.

columns.name: infinitive_unvocalized
columns.description: NFIN cell, plene unvocalized.

columns.name: citation_past_3ms_vocalized
columns.description: PST.3MSG cell, vocalized.

columns.name: citation_past_3ms_unvocalized
columns.description: PST.3MSG cell, plene unvocalized.

columns.name: gloss_en
columns.description: English translations from {{ת|אנגלית|..}} in the matched Wiktionary section(s); null if none. Section-level, not sense-disambiguated.

columns.name: sense_id
columns.description: Wiktionary homonym markers of the matched section(s) when several sections share root x binyan (e.g. 'משני:א|משני:ב'); else null.

columns.name: modern_hebrew
columns.description: True for UniMorph lexemes (source inventory = Modern Hebrew conjugation tables); True for Wiktionary-only lexemes only if a 'עברית חדשה' register tag is present; else null (unknown).

columns.name: attested
columns.description: Lexeme appears as an entry/paradigm in a lexicographic source (all real records True; synthetic False).

columns.name: has_unimorph_paradigm
columns.description: Lexeme has a UniMorph paradigm (else Wiktionary-only).

columns.name: source_primary
columns.description: 'unimorph_heb' | 'hewiktionary' | 'synthetic_v1'.

columns.name: source_ids
columns.description: '|'-joined source record identifiers (see provenance).

columns.name: match_status
columns.description: MATCHED | MATCHED_UNVOC_ONLY | ROOT_AMBIGUOUS | BINYAN_AMBIGUOUS | ROOT_AND_BINYAN_AMBIGUOUS | NO_MATCH | WIKTIONARY_ONLY | SYNTHETIC.

columns.name: match_method
columns.description: '|'-joined methods of the evidence that agrees with the assigned root/binyan.

columns.name: match_score
columns.description: Noisy-OR of agreeing evidence weights (0 if nothing assigned).

columns.name: match_evidence
columns.description: JSON list of all evidence records considered (incl. disagreeing ones).

columns.name: match_ambiguous
columns.description: True if >1 root or >1 binyan was supported by evidence.

columns.name: binyan_shape_heuristic
columns.description: Binyan predicted from the vocalized paradigm shape (VALIDATION ONLY).

columns.name: binyan_shape_rule
columns.description: Rule that produced binyan_shape_heuristic.

columns.name: voc_unvoc_pairing_status
columns.description: PAIRED | PAIRED_PARTIAL | PAIRED_TIE_IDENTICAL | AMBIGUOUS | UNPAIRED (UniMorph lexemes).

columns.name: voc_unvoc_pairing_score
columns.description: Fraction of cells whose vocalized and plene forms agree on letters modulo ו/י.

columns.name: gizra_labels
columns.description: Traditional גזרה labels stated by the matched Wiktionary entries of this lexeme.

columns.name: wiktionary_registers
columns.description: {{רובד}} register tags in matched Wiktionary sections.

columns.name: n_cells
columns.description: Number of paradigm cells in forms table.

columns.name: past_expected_cells
columns.description: Always 9 (canonical past paradigm).

columns.name: past_observed_cells
columns.description: Number of the 9 canonical past cells with a vocalized form.

columns.name: past_completeness
columns.description: past_observed_cells / 9.

columns.name: past_complete
columns.description: past_observed_cells == 9.

columns.name: ud_attested
columns.description: Some plene form of this lexeme occurs as a verb form in UniMorph from_UD_unvoc (surface match only; may be a homograph).

columns.name: confidence_root
columns.description: Noisy-OR of agreeing root evidence weights; 0 if missing/ambiguous; halved if ROOT_FORM_MISMATCH.

columns.name: confidence_binyan
columns.description: Noisy-OR of agreeing binyan evidence weights; 0 if missing/ambiguous; halved if shape heuristic disagrees.

columns.name: confidence_lexeme
columns.description: min(confidence_root, confidence_binyan) x (1 if voc/unvoc PAIRED else 0.8).

columns.name: quality_tier
columns.description: GOLD | SILVER | QUESTIONABLE (see README).

columns.name: quality_flags
columns.description: '|'-joined flags; null if none.

columns.name: form_id
columns.description: '<lexeme_id>.<canonical_cell>' (unique: one row per lexeme x cell).

columns.name: lexeme_id
columns.description: FK to lexemes.

columns.name: root_id
columns.description: Copy of lexemes.root_id (analysis convenience).

columns.name: form_raw
columns.description: Surface string exactly as in the primary source (vocalized source when available).

columns.name: form_nfc
columns.description: NFC(form_raw).

columns.name: form_vocalized
columns.description: NFC vocalized form (null if the only source is unvocalized).

columns.name: form_unvocalized
columns.description: NFC plene (ktiv male) form from the unvocalized source; null if unavailable. NOT derived by stripping.

columns.name: form_stripped
columns.description: strip_niqqud(form_vocalized): defective (ktiv haser) spelling, deterministic.

columns.name: form_vocalized_variants
columns.description: '|'-joined other vocalized forms given for the same lexeme x cell (e.g. duplicate source paradigms, Wiktionary variants).

columns.name: form_unvocalized_variants
columns.description: '|'-joined other plene spellings given for the same lexeme x cell.

columns.name: pos
columns.description: 'V' or 'V.MSDR' (verbal noun).

columns.name: finiteness
columns.description: FIN | NFIN.

columns.name: tense
columns.description: PST | PRS | FUT | NA.

columns.name: aspect
columns.description: Always NA (not morphologically marked / not annotated).

columns.name: mood
columns.description: IND | IMP | NA.

columns.name: person
columns.description: 1 | 2 | 3 | NA (present participles and non-finite forms: NA).

columns.name: number
columns.description: SG | PL | NA.

columns.name: gender
columns.description: MASC | FEM | NA (1st person and PST.3PL: NA -- not expressed).

columns.name: voice
columns.description: Always NA: voice is not annotated by the sources; the binyan column carries voice-related information.

columns.name: binyan
columns.description: Copy of lexemes.binyan.

columns.name: canonical_cell
columns.description: e.g. PST.1SG PST.2MSG PST.3PL PRS.FSG FUT.3MPL IMP.2FSG NFIN MSDR.

columns.name: is_past_cell
columns.description: canonical_cell in the 9 canonical past cells.

columns.name: unimorph_tag_raw
columns.description: Original UniMorph tag (null for Wiktionary-only forms).

columns.name: is_syncretic
columns.description: Another cell of the same lexeme has an identical VOCALIZED form.

columns.name: syncretism_group
columns.description: '<lexeme_id>:V<k>' shared by cells with identical vocalized forms; null if unique.

columns.name: is_syncretic_unvocalized
columns.description: Another cell of the same lexeme has an identical PLENE UNVOCALIZED form.

columns.name: syncretism_group_unvocalized
columns.description: '<lexeme_id>:U<k>' shared by cells with identical plene forms; null if unique.

columns.name: plene_consistent
columns.description: Vocalized and plene forms agree on letters modulo ו/י (null if either missing).

columns.name: wiktionary_corroborated
columns.description: True: a Wiktionary table gives the same vocalized form in this cell; False: it gives a different one (conflict); null: no Wiktionary table value.

columns.name: ud_attested
columns.description: form_unvocalized occurs among UD-derived verb forms (surface match only).

columns.name: is_attested
columns.description: Form is taken from a source (not generated).

columns.name: is_generated
columns.description: Form was generated by a program (synthetic data only).

columns.name: source_primary
columns.description: 'unimorph_heb' | 'hewiktionary' | 'synthetic_v1'.

columns.name: source_ids
columns.description: '|'-joined source record identifiers.

columns.name: confidence
columns.description: confidence_lexeme x form-level factor (1; 0.5 if a form-level check failed).

columns.name: quality_tier
columns.description: GOLD | SILVER | QUESTIONABLE; never better than the lexeme's tier.

columns.name: quality_flags
columns.description: '|'-joined flags; null if none.

columns.name: provenance_id
columns.description: Unique row ID.

columns.name: canonical_record_id
columns.description: root_id / lexeme_id / form_id.

columns.name: record_type
columns.description: root | lexeme | form.

columns.name: field_supported
columns.description: What this source record supports (e.g. form_vocalized, form_unvocalized, root, binyan, paradigm).

columns.name: source_name
columns.description: unimorph_heb | hewiktionary | synthetic_v1.

columns.name: source_url
columns.description: URL (UniMorph: blob URL at pinned commit with #L<line>; Wiktionary: page at pinned revision).

columns.name: source_file
columns.description: File name within the source (UniMorph file / dump file name).

columns.name: source_version_or_commit
columns.description: Git commit or dump date.

columns.name: source_record_identifier
columns.description: e.g. 'heb_voc:1234' or 'wikt:page=<id>:rev=<id>:sec=<offset>:tpl=<k>'.

columns.name: source_line_if_available
columns.description: 1-based line number in source file.

columns.name: retrieval_date
columns.description: Date the raw source was retrieved (ISO).

columns.name: parser_version
columns.description: Version of the parser that read this record.

columns.name: raw_source_value
columns.description: The raw source text supporting the field (line / template / cell value).

columns.name: check_id
columns.description: Unique row ID.

columns.name: record_id
columns.description: Affected record (or '*' for table-level checks).

columns.name: record_type
columns.description: root | lexeme | form | table | source.

columns.name: check_name
columns.description: Name of the check (see README).

columns.name: severity
columns.description: ERROR | WARNING | INFO.

columns.name: details
columns.description: Human-readable details / values involved.
